transcript.text: I didn't have a large account and I bet
you don't either. So, trading stocks
that don't move much isn't going to
produce a lot of profit. And I had to
learn all of that the hard way. So,
these are my five criteria for stock
selection. We've got four criteria that
represent demand and one that represent
supply. The stock has to be up at least
10% on the day already before I'm even
going to look at it. It needs to have
five times relative volume. There needs
to be news. And most day traders prefer
stocks between 2 and 20. The supply, the
number of shares available to trade
should be less than 10 million shares.
Now, it doesn't mean that I won't
occasionally trade a stock that's a 15

metadata.title: How I Decide What Stocks to Trade
